description: This file implements a NetworkManager proxy for GNOME, handling network interface states, IP configurations, WiFi operations, and hostname settings within a Linux environment, utilizing libnm and related utilities.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing network management functions including interface control, IP configuration, WiFi operations, and hostname management.

methods.name: SetHostname
methods.description: Sets the DHCP hostname for all relevant network connections.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations, primarily setting hostname.

methods.name: platform_logging
methods.description: Adjusts logging level for network manager daemon.

methods.name: platform_init
methods.description: Initializes network manager client, device properties, and event monitoring.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of available network interfaces (WiFi and Ethernet).

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks whether specified network interface is enabled.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP address, gateway, DNS, and other network settings for a given interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP address configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Initiates WiFi scan with optional frequency and SSID filtering.

methods.name: StopWiFiScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves info about the currently connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: GetWifiState
methods.description: Gets current WiFi radio state.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Stops ongoing WPS process.
